comparisons.reason: The constructs differ. Left is 1 if any comment directly argues against the OP's view, which is a stance of challenge or rebuttal. Right is 1 if any comment explicitly quotes or references specific OP text, whether or not it endorses or challenges that text. A comment can rebut the view in general terms without quoting anything, and a comment can quote OP text while agreeing, so each predicate can be true without the other. The null and empty rules also differ. Right returns null for an empty-of-parse list, and a clear positive quote can still yield 1 when OP context is missing. Left returns null whenever OP context is missing.
